title: The gym-owner site offers to come to any gym and set it up in person, with no area or limit
what: The gym-owner site says twice that if a gym leaves its number, MettleUp calls and sets it up with them at their gym. The About page also promises free set-up, moving the data and free staff training. MettleUp is one person in Jaipur, and the form takes any city in India. Nothing says which cities a visit covers, or that set-up elsewhere is done by phone or video.
expected: The promise says where an in-person visit is possible (for example Jaipur) and that other gyms are set up by phone or video call, so a gym far away is not let down.
fix_line: Say in the answer and above the form that visits are in Jaipur and other gyms are set up on a call

title: Every public contact path ends at one person, with a 48-hour complaint promise and no cover when he is away
what: The contact page, refunds, delivery, terms, privacy notice and both marketing sites all give one email address and one phone number, and name the founder as the only Grievance Officer. The contact page promises to confirm every complaint within 48 hours. Nothing on any page, and nothing written for the business, says who answers when the founder is ill, travelling or has lost his phone, or sends an automatic 'we got it' reply.
expected: Either a second person or an automatic acknowledgement keeps the 48-hour promise, and a written plan says who answers the email and phone if the founder cannot.
who: gym owners and members with a complaint
fix_line: Add an automatic reply that confirms receipt and write down who covers the inbox and phone
